summary: Inspected all 19 files in the work unit. Every file contains formal mathematical declarations, definitions, lemmas, theorems, or tactic/command infrastructure directly supporting mathematical formalization. The algebra file (PolynomialsAsLists.lean) provides a ring isomorphism between list-based and mathlib polynomials with 100+ lemmas. The elliptic curve files (7 files) define LMFDB-matching concepts (abc quality, Frey curves, reduced minimal models, integral points, reduction types, supersingularity). The finite field irreducibility file (52KB) develops Rabin's test, degree analysis, and multiple certificate structures. The modular forms q-expansion suite (8 files) builds a complete bridge from list-based truncated power series through generic E₄/E₆ polynomial evaluation to mathlib's ModularForm.discriminant, including Sturm bounds and integer-optimized evaluation. The Brillhart file (25KB) formalizes prime-witness irreducibility certificates with scaled Cauchy bounds. The two tactic files provide certified #qexp commands and qexp_coeff tactics. The unitmk file defines a number field with LMFDB axioms. All are substantive, non-empty, hand-written Lean source with mathematical content; none are pure imports, generated, or empty. Per FILTER-002/004/021/025, the default retain disposition applies.
